items.title: Software Engineer
items.summary: Designs, builds and maintains the software behind apps, websites and enterprise systems.
items.dayInLife: Stand-up with the team, two focused coding blocks, a code review, and a bug fix shipped before evening.

pathways.label: B.Tech Computer Science via JEE
pathways.degree: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering (4 yrs)
pathways.costNote: IIT/NIT fees about ₹2.2 lakh a year plus hostel; private colleges cost more.

pathways.label: BS Computer Science in the US
pathways.costNote: Before aid; MIT, Stanford and CMU meet need for some internationals.

pathways.label: BCS / BASc in Canada with co-op
pathways.degree: Bachelor of Computer Science, co-op (4-5 yrs)
pathways.costNote: Waterloo co-op terms pay roughly ₹15-25 lakh in total over the degree.

items.title: Data Analyst
items.summary: Turns raw business data into dashboards and answers that help teams decide.
items.dayInLife: Pull numbers with SQL, clean them in Python or Excel, build a dashboard, and walk a manager through what changed this week.

pathways.label: B.Tech CSE or Data Science via JEE
pathways.costNote: Engineering route; strongest placements.

pathways.label: BSc Statistics / Economics or BCom + certificate
pathways.costNote: Delhi University fees are low; a ₹30,000-80,000 certificate closes the tools gap.

pathways.label: BSc Data Science / Economics in the UK
pathways.costNote: Graduate Route visa allows 18 months of UK work after study.

items.title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
items.summary: Builds and deploys machine-learning models, from recommendation systems to language models.
items.dayInLife: Review overnight training runs, debug a data pipeline, read a new paper, and ship an improved model behind a feature flag.

pathways.label: B.Tech CSE / AI via JEE, then M.Tech or industry
pathways.degree: B.Tech CSE or AI and Data Science (4 yrs)
pathways.costNote: Many roles prefer an M.Tech or MS; add ₹2-40 lakh if you do one.

pathways.label: BS CS with ML focus in the US
pathways.costNote: OPT/STEM OPT gives up to 3 years of US work after graduation.

pathways.label: BCS in Canada (Toronto/Waterloo AI cluster)
pathways.costNote: Toronto-Waterloo is a major AI research hub (Vector Institute).

items.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
items.summary: Protects networks and data by monitoring threats, testing defences and responding to attacks.
items.dayInLife: Triage alerts in the security operations centre, investigate a phishing attempt, patch a vulnerable server and write the incident report.

pathways.label: B.Tech CSE (cybersecurity) + certifications
pathways.degree: B.Tech CSE with Cyber Security (4 yrs)
pathways.costNote: Add ₹40,000-1.5 lakh for CompTIA Security+ / CEH certifications.

pathways.label: BS Computer Science / Cybersecurity in the US
pathways.costNote: Government security roles in the US usually need citizenship.

items.title: Game Developer
items.summary: Programs gameplay, physics and tools for mobile, PC and console games.
items.dayInLife: Prototype a new mechanic in Unity, fix frame-rate issues, playtest with designers and polish a level.

pathways.label: B.Tech CSE + game portfolio
pathways.costNote: Portfolio of shipped games matters more than college name.

pathways.label: Computer Science / Game Design in Canada
pathways.costNote: Montreal and Vancouver are big game-studio cities (Ubisoft, EA).

items.title: Mechanical Engineer
items.summary: Designs machines and thermal systems, from car engines to HVAC and robotics.
items.dayInLife: Model a part in SolidWorks, run a stress simulation, visit the shop floor to check a prototype and update the bill of materials.

pathways.label: B.Tech Mechanical via JEE
pathways.costNote: Core PSU jobs via GATE are a common next step.

pathways.label: MEng Mechanical in the UK
pathways.costNote: Integrated master's is 4 years; ESAT needed for Imperial and Cambridge.

items.title: Civil Engineer
items.summary: Plans and builds roads, bridges, metros, water systems and buildings.
items.dayInLife: Check site progress against drawings, review a structural calculation, meet contractors and sign off a concrete pour.

pathways.label: B.Tech Civil via JEE
pathways.costNote: Government routes via GATE and ESE (UPSC) are common.

pathways.label: BASc Civil Engineering in Canada
pathways.costNote: Licensing as a P.Eng needs 4 years of supervised work.

items.title: Electronics and Electrical Engineer
items.summary: Designs chips, circuits, embedded systems and power networks.
items.dayInLife: Simulate a circuit, debug firmware on a dev board, review a PCB layout with the team and test a batch of prototypes.

pathways.label: B.Tech ECE / EE via JEE
pathways.costNote: India's semiconductor push (ISM fabs) is creating VLSI roles.

pathways.label: BS Electrical Engineering in the US
pathways.degree: BS Electrical and Computer Engineering (4 yrs)
pathways.costNote: STEM OPT allows 3 years of work.

items.title: Aerospace Engineer
items.summary: Designs and tests aircraft, satellites, rockets and drones.
items.dayInLife: Run aerodynamic simulations, review test data from a wind tunnel or engine run, and document design changes for certification.

pathways.label: B.Tech Aerospace via JEE Advanced
pathways.costNote: ISRO hires through its own ICRB exam; IIST is another route.

pathways.label: BS Aerospace Engineering in the US
pathways.costNote: Defence roles need US citizenship; commercial space is more open.

pathways.label: MEng Aeronautical Engineering in the UK
pathways.costNote: Rolls-Royce and Airbus UK recruit graduates.

items.title: Architect
items.summary: Designs buildings and spaces that are safe, useful and beautiful.
items.dayInLife: Sketch concepts for a client, develop drawings in AutoCAD and Revit, coordinate with structural engineers and visit a site.

pathways.label: B.Arch via NATA or JEE Main Paper 2
pathways.costNote: Registration with the Council of Architecture after B.Arch.

pathways.label: BA Architecture (RIBA Part 1) in the UK
pathways.costNote: Full UK qualification takes about 7 years; most return after Part 1 or 2.

items.title: Doctor (MBBS)
items.summary: Diagnoses and treats patients; most go on to specialise after MBBS.
items.dayInLife: Ward rounds, an outpatient clinic of 40 patients, reviewing test results and handing over to the night team.

pathways.label: MBBS at a government college via NEET
pathways.costNote: Government seats cost little; coaching ₹1.5-4 lakh; NEET PG for specialisation.

pathways.label: MBBS at a private / deemed college via NEET
pathways.costNote: Deemed-university MBBS fees run ₹15-30 lakh a year.

pathways.label: MBBS / MBChB in the UK with UCAT
pathways.costNote: International places are very limited (about 7.5%); NHS foundation training after.

items.title: Dentist (BDS)
items.summary: Diagnoses and treats problems of the teeth, gums and mouth.
items.dayInLife: Fillings, a root canal and two consultations in the morning; orthodontic reviews and lab-work checks after lunch.

pathways.label: BDS via NEET
pathways.costNote: Many dentists open their own clinic; setup costs ₹15-30 lakh.

items.title: Pharmacist
items.summary: Ensures medicines are safe and effective, in hospitals, pharma companies and regulatory roles.
items.dayInLife: Check prescriptions for interactions, counsel patients, or in industry run quality tests on a new batch.

pathways.label: B.Pharm via state CETs / NEET-based admission
pathways.costNote: Pharm.D (6 yrs) suits hospital clinical roles.

pathways.label: BSc Pharmacy in Canada
pathways.costNote: Long but leads to licensed practice.

items.title: Registered Nurse
items.summary: Provides and coordinates patient care in hospitals, communities and abroad.
items.dayInLife: Hand-over, medication rounds for eight patients, wound care, updating charts and supporting a doctor during a procedure.

pathways.label: BSc Nursing (state or institutional entrance)
pathways.costNote: Indian-trained nurses are in demand in the UK, Gulf and Australia.

pathways.label: Bachelor of Nursing in Australia
pathways.costNote: Registered nurse is on Australia's skilled occupation list.

items.title: Physiotherapist
items.summary: Helps people recover movement after injury, surgery or illness, including sports rehab.
items.dayInLife: Assess a post-surgery knee, run rehab sessions, plan exercises for a cricketer and update treatment notes.

pathways.label: BPT (Bachelor of Physiotherapy)
pathways.costNote: Sports physio roles pay well with an MPT.

pathways.label: Physiotherapy in Australia
pathways.costNote: Strong demand; on the skilled occupation list.

items.title: Biotechnologist
items.summary: Uses living cells and molecules to make vaccines, drugs, enzymes and crops.
items.dayInLife: Run PCR and cell-culture experiments, analyse data, troubleshoot a protocol and present results at the lab meeting.

pathways.label: B.Tech / BSc Biotechnology, then MSc or PhD
pathways.costNote: Research roles usually need a master's; PhD funded in India.

pathways.label: BSc Biochemistry / Biomedical Sciences in the UK
pathways.costNote: Oxford-Cambridge-London golden triangle has many biotech start-ups.

items.title: Research Scientist (Physical Sciences)
items.summary: Discovers new knowledge in physics, chemistry or maths at universities, ISRO, DRDO or industry labs.
items.dayInLife: Design an experiment or simulation, read papers, analyse results, mentor a junior student and draft a paper.

pathways.label: BS-MS at IISc / IISER, then PhD
pathways.costNote: PhD stipends (₹37,000-42,000 a month) cover living costs.

pathways.label: BS in the US, then funded PhD
pathways.costNote: US PhDs are fully funded; the cost is the undergraduate degree.

items.title: Environmental Scientist
items.summary: Studies pollution, climate and ecosystems and advises on sustainability and compliance.
items.dayInLife: Collect water samples at a site, model emissions data, and write an environmental impact report for a client.

pathways.label: BSc Environmental Science, then MSc
pathways.costNote: ESG and climate-finance roles are growing fast.

pathways.label: Bachelor of Environmental Science in Australia
pathways.costNote: Australia has strong climate and water research.

items.title: Chartered Accountant
items.summary: Audits companies, advises on tax and prepares the financial statements investors rely on.
items.dayInLife: Audit fieldwork at a client, reconcile ledgers, review GST filings and draft an audit observation for the partner.

pathways.label: CA via ICAI: Foundation, Intermediate, articleship, Final
pathways.degree: CA (ICAI), often with a BCom alongside
pathways.costNote: ICAI fees are about ₹1 lakh in total; coaching adds ₹1-3 lakh. Pass rates are low, so 5-6 years is typical.

pathways.label: BSc Accounting and Finance + ACCA/ACA in the UK
pathways.degree: BSc Accounting and Finance (3 yrs) + ACA
pathways.costNote: Big Four graduate schemes pay while you qualify.

items.title: Investment Banker
items.summary: Advises companies on mergers, acquisitions and raising capital through IPOs and debt.
items.dayInLife: Update a valuation model, build a pitch deck for a client, join diligence calls and work late on a live deal.

pathways.label: BCom / Economics at a top college, then MBA
pathways.degree: BCom/BA Economics (3 yrs) or IPM (5 yrs) + MBA
pathways.costNote: IIM MBA fees are about ₹25 lakh; IPM Indore integrates UG and MBA.

pathways.label: BSc Economics / Finance in London
pathways.costNote: London summer internships convert to analyst offers.

pathways.label: BS/BA Finance or Economics in the US
pathways.costNote: Wall Street recruits heavily from target schools.

items.title: Financial Analyst
items.summary: Analyses companies, budgets and investments to guide business or investor decisions.
items.dayInLife: Update the monthly forecast, explain a cost overrun to a manager, and research a listed company for the investment committee.

pathways.label: BCom / BBA + CFA Level 1-2
pathways.costNote: CFA exam fees are about ₹1.2-1.5 lakh per level.

pathways.label: BCom / BBA in Canada
pathways.costNote: Toronto's Bay Street banks hire co-op students.

items.title: Actuary
items.summary: Uses maths and statistics to price insurance, pensions and financial risk.
items.dayInLife: Build a pricing model for a health product, test assumptions against claims data and present results to the risk committee.

pathways.label: BSc Statistics / Maths + IAI actuarial exams
pathways.degree: BSc (3 yrs) + Institute of Actuaries of India exams
pathways.costNote: Pay rises with each paper passed; full fellowship takes 6-8 years.

pathways.label: BSc Actuarial Science in the UK
pathways.costNote: Accredited degrees give exemptions from IFoA papers.

items.title: Management Consultant
items.summary: Helps companies solve their biggest problems: growth, cost, strategy and change.
items.dayInLife: Client workshop in the morning, analyse survey data, build slides with the team and pressure-test the storyline with the partner.

pathways.label: Top UG (IIT / SRCC / IPM) then IIM MBA
pathways.costNote: MBB firms hire mainly from IIM A/B/C and IIT campuses.

pathways.label: BSc Management / Economics in the UK
pathways.costNote: Big Four and boutique consultancies run graduate schemes.

pathways.label: BBA / HBA in Canada
pathways.costNote: Ivey (Western) and Rotman (Toronto) place into consulting.

items.title: Business Analyst
items.summary: Bridges business teams and tech teams: defines what to build and measures if it worked.
items.dayInLife: Interview users about a process, write requirements, check a dashboard and agree priorities with product and engineering.

pathways.label: BBA / BCom / B.Tech + analytics
pathways.costNote: Fast entry; an MBA later boosts pay.

pathways.label: BCom / BBA in Canada with co-op
pathways.costNote: Co-op terms build a local CV.

pathways.label: BSc Business Management in the UK
pathways.costNote: Graduate Route visa: 18 months to find work.

items.title: Product Manager
items.summary: Decides what a tech product should do next and leads designers and engineers to ship it.
items.dayInLife: Review user metrics, run a design review, prioritise the backlog with engineering and talk to three customers.

pathways.label: B.Tech, a few years as engineer/analyst, then APM or MBA
pathways.costNote: Some companies hire APMs straight from IIT/BITS campuses.

pathways.label: CS or Economics in the US, then APM programme
pathways.costNote: Google and Meta APM programmes hire new grads.

items.title: Marketing Manager
items.summary: Plans how a brand reaches and persuades customers, across digital, retail and media.
items.dayInLife: Review campaign performance, brief an agency on a new ad, plan the festive-season budget and check social sentiment.

pathways.label: BBA / BMS then MBA Marketing
pathways.costNote: FMCG management-trainee roles after an MBA pay best.

pathways.label: BSc Marketing / Management in the UK
pathways.costNote: Graduate schemes at Unilever UK, P&G, Diageo.

items.title: Entrepreneur / Startup Founder
items.summary: Starts and grows a new business, from first customer to a funded team.
items.dayInLife: Talk to customers, fix a sales problem, interview a hire, review cash in the bank and pitch an investor.

pathways.label: Any strong UG + build while studying (incubators, Startup India)
pathways.costNote: Most founders first work 2-3 years at a startup; cost depends on the college.

pathways.label: US degree + startup ecosystem
pathways.costNote: Visa rules make founding in the US hard right after graduation.

items.title: Economist
items.summary: Studies data on markets, prices and policy to forecast and advise governments, banks and companies.
items.dayInLife: Update an inflation model, read RBI and IMF releases, write a research note and brief a client on what it means.

pathways.label: BA Economics (Hons) then MA (DSE / JNU / ISI)
pathways.costNote: Indian Economic Service (UPSC) and RBI Grade B are government routes.

pathways.label: BSc Economics in the UK
pathways.costNote: Government Economic Service and consultancies hire graduates.

items.title: Supply Chain Manager
items.summary: Gets products from suppliers to customers on time and at the right cost.
items.dayInLife: Check warehouse stock, re-route a delayed shipment, negotiate with a transporter and review delivery metrics.

pathways.label: BBA / B.Tech, then MBA Operations
pathways.costNote: Quick-commerce has created many entry roles.

pathways.label: BCom Supply Chain in Canada
pathways.costNote: Logistics roles are in demand in Toronto and Vancouver.

items.title: Lawyer (Corporate and Litigation)
items.summary: Advises clients on deals and disputes, drafts contracts and argues cases in court.
items.dayInLife: Draft a share-purchase agreement, research case law for a dispute, join a client call and review a junior's memo.

pathways.label: Five-year BA LLB at a National Law University via CLAT
pathways.costNote: NLU fees are ₹2.5-3.5 lakh a year incl. hostel; CLAT coaching ₹60,000-1.5 lakh.

pathways.label: LLB in the UK, then SQE (or return to India via Bar Council)
pathways.costNote: Practising in India after a UK LLB needs Bar Council of India recognition steps.

items.title: Civil Services Officer (IAS / IPS / IFS)
items.summary: Runs districts, ministries and embassies; selected through the UPSC Civil Services Examination.
items.dayInLife: As a district collector: review a flood-relief plan, hold a public hearing, inspect a hospital and chair a meeting on schemes.

pathways.label: Any graduation, then UPSC Prelims, Mains and Interview
pathways.costNote: Coaching ₹1.5-3 lakh plus Delhi living costs; salary starts at Level 10 (₹56,100 basic).

items.title: Public Policy Analyst
items.summary: Researches social problems and recommends policies to governments, think tanks and NGOs.
items.dayInLife: Analyse survey data on a welfare scheme, interview officials, write a policy brief and present it to a ministry team.

pathways.label: BA Political Science / Economics, then MPP
pathways.degree: BA (3-4 yrs) + Master of Public Policy (2 yrs)
pathways.costNote: Fellowships like LAMP and CM fellowships are common entry points.

pathways.label: BSc Politics / PPE in the UK
pathways.costNote: Think tanks in London hire graduates as researchers.

items.title: Journalist
items.summary: Finds, verifies and tells stories for newspapers, TV, digital and podcasts.
items.dayInLife: Pitch a story, call sources, attend a press conference, write and fact-check the piece and record a short video version.

pathways.label: BA Journalism / English, then PG diploma (IIMC / ACJ)
pathways.costNote: A strong clip portfolio matters more than the degree.

pathways.label: BA Journalism / English in the UK
pathways.costNote: Competitive; many work freelance at first.

items.title: Public Relations and Communications Manager
items.summary: Shapes how the public sees a company, leader or cause through media, events and crisis communication.
items.dayInLife: Pitch a founder interview to journalists, draft a press release, prep a spokesperson and track media coverage.

pathways.label: BA Mass Communication / BMS
pathways.costNote: Agencies hire interns; a strong network matters.

items.title: Psychologist (Clinical / Counselling)
items.summary: Assesses and supports mental health through therapy, testing and counselling.
items.dayInLife: Four therapy sessions, a psychometric assessment, case notes and supervision with a senior clinician.

pathways.label: BA/BSc Psychology, MA/MSc, then M.Phil Clinical (RCI)
pathways.degree: BA (3 yrs) + MA (2 yrs) + M.Phil (2 yrs) for clinical
pathways.costNote: Counselling roles open after MA; RCI licence needed to practise clinically.

pathways.label: Psychology in Australia (APAC-accredited)
pathways.costNote: Registration needs a 6-year sequence.

items.title: Teacher / Educator
items.summary: Teaches and mentors students in schools, coaching centres or online.
items.dayInLife: Teach four periods, run a lab or discussion, mark assignments, meet a parent and plan next week's lessons.

pathways.label: Subject degree + B.Ed, then CTET / school hiring
pathways.degree: BA/BSc (3 yrs) + B.Ed (2 yrs), or 4-yr ITEP
pathways.costNote: International-board schools (IB/Cambridge) pay 1.5-2x CBSE schools.

items.title: UX / Product Designer
items.summary: Designs how apps and websites work and feel, grounded in user research.
items.dayInLife: Run two user interviews, turn findings into Figma wireframes, review prototypes with engineers and test a new flow.

pathways.label: B.Des via NID DAT or UCEED
pathways.costNote: NID and IIT Bombay (IDC) are the top routes; portfolio matters most.

pathways.label: BS Human-Computer Interaction / Design in the US
pathways.costNote: CMU is the best-known HCI programme.

items.title: Communication / Graphic Designer
items.summary: Creates brand identities, illustrations, packaging, motion graphics and campaigns.
items.dayInLife: Sketch logo directions, build social creatives, present concepts to a client and finalise print files.

pathways.label: B.Des Communication Design via NID DAT / UCEED
pathways.costNote: Freelancing alongside a job is common.

pathways.label: BA Graphic Communication in the UK
pathways.costNote: London agencies are competitive; portfolio is key.

items.title: Fashion Designer
items.summary: Designs clothing and accessories, from sketches to production-ready collections.
items.dayInLife: Research trends, sketch a capsule collection, fit samples on a model and visit the production unit.

pathways.label: B.Des Fashion via NIFT / NID entrance
pathways.costNote: NIFT runs its own entrance; NID has textile and apparel design.

items.title: Hotel and Hospitality Manager
items.summary: Runs hotel operations so guests are looked after and the property makes money.
items.dayInLife: Morning briefing, check occupancy and complaints, walk the property, handle a VIP arrival and review the food cost report.

pathways.label: BHM via NCHM JEE or Manipal WGSHA
pathways.costNote: Management-trainee programmes at Taj (IHCL) and Oberoi (STEP) are the fast track.

pathways.label: Bachelor of Hospitality / Business in Australia
pathways.costNote: Post-study work rights help start a career abroad.
